dedupe_keys.name: urbaning v2x cooperative road perception dataset

description: UrbanIng-V2X records coordinated vehicles and roadside sensors for cooperative perception research. Technische Hochschule Ingolstadt and Technical University of Munich provide 34 calibrated sequences of about 20 seconds from three urban intersections in Ingolstadt, Germany. Each sequence involves two vehicles and fixed sensor poles, with RGB cameras, thermal cameras and LiDAR. The project reports 3D annotations at 10 Hz across 13 object classes, along with calibration, weather context, a Lanelet2 map and a CARLA digital twin. Harvard Dataverse lists the released archive parts and annotation files; all current file entries are unrestricted. Data access is free under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0, while repository code uses MIT. A limitation is the small set of coordinated intersections, which should not be interpreted as representative citywide traffic. The non-commercial and no-derivatives conditions also matter when redistributing processed data. Simulation uses include validating cooperative perception and comparing sensor configurations in a matched digital environment. CARLA is the stated digital-twin format; no related catalogue record was identified as a direct dependency. The repository documents conversion to OpenCOOD, but no converter, simulator or dataset payload was run or downloaded.
name: UrbanIng-V2X cooperative road perception dataset
notes: G8; G8-0185. Metadata and documentation checked. Data payloads and software execution were not tested. Simulation uses are curator interpretations.  Cited as: Chandra Sekaran, K. et al.
